decisions.reason: Defining visual object Type 1 as a grid of objects does not change the number of questions per level or their review sequence.
The visual representation assigned to Type 1 does not alter gradual progression or curriculum-block-based level splitting.
Specifying a grid-of-objects representation does not change how questions applicable to multiple levels are duplicated or assigned.
The Type 1 visual object definition neither resolves the existing Grade 5 curriculum ambiguity nor changes curriculum alignment rules.
The source defines a visual object type but does not resume or modify the deferred C# random-generator requirement.
